abstract: OBJECTIVE: The objective of this study was to investigate the preoperative diagnostic value of F-fluoro-2-deoxy-D-glucose (FDG) positron emission tomography and computed tomography (PET/CT) in patients with ovarian cancer. METHODS: One hundred sixty patients suspected of having malignant ovarian tumors were included in this study. All patients underwent FDG-PET/CT scans before operation, and the maximum standardized uptake value (SUVmax) of the primary tumor was measured. We evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of SUVmax for detecting malignancy and its relationship with histological findings. RESULTS: Postoperative pathological diagnoses showed that 67 were malignant, 14 were borderline malignant, and 79 were benign tumors. With the use of a cutoff SUVmax of 2.9 obtained from the receiver operating characteristic curve analysis, the sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, and negative predictive value for detecting malignancy were 80.6%, 94.6%, 91.5%, and 87.1%, respectively. Positive FDG accumulation (SUVmax ≥ 2.9) was shown in 89.5% of serous adenocarcinoma and in 92.3% of endometrioid adenocarcinoma. In contrast, lower frequencies of positive FDG accumulation were shown in clear cell adenocarcinoma (54.5%), mucinous adenocarcinoma (66.7%), and metastatic carcinoma (66.7%), and the median SUVmax of these 3 histological types were significantly lower than those of serous and endometrioid types. In addition, a positive FDG accumulation was shown in all patients with malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma. Finally, of the 14 borderline malignant tumors, only 2 (14.3%) showed positive FDG accumulation. CONCLUSIONS: The SUVmax on FDG-PET/CT is useful for differentiating ovarian cancer from borderline or benign tumor with a high specificity and positive predictive value. However, our data also demonstrated a lower FDG uptake value in clear cell or mucinous histological finding, suggesting that SUVmax may vary depending on the tumor histological subtype.
abstract_ja: 目的：卵巣がん患者における術前のF-フルオロ-2-デオキシ-D-グルコース(FDG)陽電子放射断層撮影およびコンピュータ断層撮影(PET/CT)の診断価値を検討すること。方法：悪性卵巣腫瘍が疑われる160例を本研究に組み入れた。全例が手術前にFDG-PET/CT検査を受け、原発腫瘍の最大標準化摂取値(SUVmax)を測定した。悪性の検出におけるSUVmaxの診断精度と組織学的所見との関連を評価した。結果：術後病理診断では、悪性67例、境界悪性14例、良性79例であった。受信者動作特性曲線解析から得たSUVmaxのカットオフ値2.9を用いると、悪性の検出における感度、特異度、陽性的中率、陰性的中率はそれぞれ80.6%、94.6%、91.5%、87.1%であった。漿液性腺癌の89.5%、類内膜腺癌の92.3%でFDGの陽性集積(SUVmax ≥ 2.9)が認められた。一方、明細胞腺癌(54.5%)、粘液性腺癌(66.7%)、転移性癌(66.7%)ではFDG陽性集積の頻度が低く、これら3つの組織型のSUVmax中央値は漿液性型および類内膜型より有意に低かった。さらに、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化を伴う全例でFDGの陽性集積が認められた。最後に、境界悪性腫瘍14例中、FDG陽性集積を示したのは2例(14.3%)のみであった。結論：FDG-PET/CTのSUVmaxは、特異度および陽性的中率が高く、卵巣がんを境界悪性または良性腫瘍と鑑別するのに有用である。しかし、本研究のデータでは、明細胞型または粘液性の組織所見においてFDG取り込み値が低いことも示されており、SUVmaxは腫瘍の組織学的亜型により変動しうることが示唆された。
